v.t: This is the third time I am coming to you. In the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Deut 19:15 (14 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: I told you before, and foretell you, as if I were present, the second time; and being absent now I write to them which heretofore have sinned, and to all other, that, if I come again, I will not spare:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Since ye seek a proof of Christ speaking in me, which to you-ward is not weak, but is mighty in you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For though he was crucified through weakness, yet he liveth by the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we shall live with him by the power of God toward you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves. Know ye not your own selves, how that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).
tm.ot: Is strongly linked by readers to Lam 3:40 (82 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Now I pray to God that ye do no evil; not that we should appear approved, but that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: For we are glad, when we are weak, and ye are strong: and this also we wish, even your perfection.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Therefore I write these things being absent, lest being present I should use sharpness, according to the power which the Lord hath given me to edification, and not to destruction.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Finally, brethren, farewell. Be perfect, be of good comfort, be of one mind, live in peace; and the God of love and peace shall be with you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: Greet one another with an holy kiss.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).
Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).

v.t: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with you all. Amen.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (2 Cor 1:1).
